widget_id.label: Widget ID
widget_id.info: Starts with wid_. Hamnivo Studio shows it in the install code, as data-widget-id.

chat_address.label: Chat address
chat_address.info: Where Hamnivo Chat runs, for example https://chat.example.com. It is the start of the install code's src, before /loader.js.

api_address.label: API address (optional)
api_address.info: The Hamnivo API of the same installation, for example https://api.example.com. It is the install code's data-api. Leave it empty to use the chat's own default.
